pkgmetadata.longdescription: A small local language model for QindaNote's live notes on machines without a large GPU: Qwen3.5-4B (GGUF, pinned Hugging Face revision) served by llama.cpp's llama-server on 127.0.0.1:8080 through a socket-activated systemd proxy, so the model is loaded only while a client uses it and unloaded after it has been idle. With local Whisper this makes live notes work fully offline.

use.flag: Also install the vision projector (0.67 GB) so screen captures reach the model
